audit.summary: The latest paper still gives two inequivalent replay procedures and two different curriculum priority functions. Exact small witnesses show an actor-gradient sign reversal for stored-action replay and a priority-ranking reversal for accumulated versus plain positive TD errors. These are Minor written-method inconsistencies; the actual training path remains unverified.
limitations: No world model, policy or old verifier was executed. The current author project page still lists code as forthcoming. The mathematical witnesses distinguish the written procedures but do not identify which procedure generated the reported training results.

proposition.claim:
The body says current-policy rollouts restart from sampled contexts; Algorithm 2 instead loads a saved trajectory and updates its stored actions without behavior correction.

Eq.(7) sums future discounted positive TD residuals for every starting position; Algorithm 2 takes their plain mean.
